card.name: Words just before a number or hyphen
card.fires_on: Words that come right before a number or hyphenated number, such as Week, Day, type, IL, mid and glucose. The next character is usually a space plus digit or a hyphen.

modes.label: Time labels before a number
modes.description: Week or Day followed by a number in dosing schedules.

modes.label: Names before a hyphen or digit
modes.description: A name or term that continues with a hyphen and number, such as IL-6, mid-20th, or type 2.

card.writes: It promotes underscore, hyphen and asterisk joiners and suppresses hyphen-plus-letter pieces, favoring a hyphen or digit link next.
card.plain: It marks a word that is about to be followed by a number or hyphen, like Day 1 or IL-6.
